newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian OLOs recover, Bfr weakness puzzles dealers.
newsitem.headline: Belgian OLOs recover, Bfr weakness puzzles dealers.

text.p: Belgian OLO futures recovered from a dip at the start to stand nearly unchanged by mid-morning, but the Belgian franc remained relatively weak at 20.6400/05 to the mark, with dealers at a loss for explanations.
The franc's ERM midpoint to the mark is 20.6255, and it has been trading above this level for most of the year, although dealers see no fundamental reason for it.

"As EMU nears, one would expect the franc to trade around the midpoint, I do not see why it should be above the midpoint," one dealer said. He added that with the franc above the midpoint and the OLO/Bund spread at just 11 bp, OLOs were a buy.

Traders were awaiting this afternoon's exchange auction, where the Treasury is offering OLOs 27 (4.00 pct, Jan 2000), 6 (9.00 pct, March 2003), 19 (6.50 pct, March 2005) and 26 (6.25 pct, March 2007) in exchange for OLO 15 and OLO 8.
It will be the last chance for the Treasury to reduce the amount outstanding in OLO 15 -- still 98 billion -- before its final maturity on May 25. OLO 8 matures in August.
Dealers said they expected the Treasury to take a lot of OLO 15 paper out of the market today.
-- Geert De Clercq, Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6813, Fax +32 2 230 7710
